name: catalog/batch_failed
description: A batch was marked failed for a real fault (ERROR; a batch with no usable photos is a WARNING and is not counted), or the sweeper stopped it after two hours without progress.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND ((jsonPayload.message="batch failed" AND severity=ERROR) OR jsonPayload.message=~"^batch swept")
